scope: Independent short stress split, never used to tune the nine fixed policies or neural interface. This supplement does not modify or pool the core evaluation-v1 experiment.
stress_scene: One body starts at energy 0.35 with nearby food, three separated obstacles, an expanding shadow and an opposite translating shadow. Shadows are visible and stationary for ten action windows, then execute the same predefined motion in both conditions. No physical threat debit. This specific combined arrangement and sensory noise are absent from training.
stress_noise: Independent named per-body Gaussian stream adds standard deviation 0.15 to actual local occupancy and signed projection-change observations only (indices 16:48). Clip occupancy to [0,1] and change to [-1,1]. The clean condition consumes identical-size draws at amplitude zero. No world, policy or neural random stream depends on noise draws; no privileged feature is added.
stress_units: Thirty matched environment seeds for each of ten controllers under two conditions: 600 single-body episodes. Learned architecture effects retain exactly three independently trained models, crossed with the same environment units. One independently named neural input repeat per environment, paired across noise conditions; input draws and environment repetitions are distinct concepts.
shared_scene: Ten identical bodies start on a radius-3.2 ring facing a limited central food patch with two extra resources, three distant obstacles and two visual shadows. Total initial food is two simulation units and does not replenish. All ten observe the same world before any body action is applied; the authoritative World performs synchronous collision and food-allocation updates.
shared_allocation: Three ten-world cyclic blocks. Independently permute the ten controller names for each block, rotate by the within-block trial index, and retain the exact assignment table. Every controller occupies every geometric slot exactly three times over thirty environment seeds. World layout and rotation use separate environment streams.
shared_units: Thirty interacting worlds, each with one connectome and nine learned controllers. World totals and per-identity descriptive values are reported separately from single-body contrasts. Neither ten correlated bodies nor one-versus-nine aggregate counts are algorithm replicates.
timing: Neural integration remains 0.1 ms, body integration 0.01 s, action window 0.02 s. Stress duration is 1.5 simulation seconds; shared duration is 2 simulation seconds. Neither duration supports long-term memory or ecological-success conclusions. Policy inference uses the deterministic latent mean through the same action pipeline as training; recurrent state persists within each episode and resets symmetrically between episodes.
metrics: Recompute food, collision substeps, requested motor energy, final stored simulation energy, escape-drive integral and measured inference time from numeric traces using the core metric helper. Save unperturbed and applied observations, raw learned actions/log probabilities, applied actions, neural input and output rates, body states, remaining food and sampled process RSS. Physical threat debit is not applicable to these shadows.
statistics: 2000 paired bootstrap draws. For each learned architecture, resample three training seeds and the same matched environment indices across noise conditions. Publish every excluded incomplete environment with reasons. Connectome noise effects resample environment units only. Shared summaries are descriptive world-level totals and per-identity values without an algorithm-ranking contrast.
resources: One immutable full-graph structure and at most one active connectome state. One CPU thread for learned inference. Nine hundred cumulative wall seconds including setup across resumed invocations, checked at episode boundaries and action-window timeout; small recording and teardown overhead can exceed the boundary. Preserve partial records and list not-started units on cancellation, budget exhaustion or low resources.
resume: A source/config/model/data/interface lock is written before execution. Existing records require matching identity and trajectory checksum. Completed and failed records are immutable; failed trials are not silently rerun. A changed source or protocol requires a new output version. JSON contains no executable payload; NPZ loads with allow_pickle=False.
